desc: This gorgeous Kimber 1911 Sapphire Pro II 9MM pistol has a stunning high polish bright blue PVD stainless steel slide with cut scroll engraving and border, PVD coating on small parts, blue/black ball-milled G-10 thin grips, and an aluminum satin silver frame with a KimPro II finish, ball-milled grooves front strap checkering, and grooved aluminum mainspring housing. Other features include fixed tactical wedge night sights, solid aluminium match grade trigger, 4" stainless steel match grade barrel, and an ambidextrous thumb safety.
